detailed_description:
High-end 2.5D semi-realistic AI manju guoman epic cinema rendering with crisp golden sword-stream physics, grounded stone-platform weight, and unidirectional outward beam propagation.

[Shot 1] High-end 2.5D AI manju epic rendering on <Subject 2>. Action begins within the opening half-second: <Subject 1> kneels stationary facing directly toward the camera at the center of the flat level dark flagstone platform of <Subject 2>, his left boot sole and right knee planted immovably on a single stone slab with his left hand resting steady on his knee while gale wind whips his silver hair and white-gold robes outward; twelve sharp luminous golden swords materialize in a symmetric fan ring behind his back and rapidly multiply into hundreds of radiant golden swords fanning upward into vast twin wings beneath the dark storm clouds as loose pebbles lift around his planted knee. Locked low-angle wide camera tilts upward very gently.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, the camera cuts to a bold foreshortened medium close-up with <Subject 1> standing firm on the right side of the frame against misty canyon crags, driving his clenched right fist straight toward the center-left lens and holding the extended punch rock-steady; spinning golden vortex rings and dense golden sparks coil rapidly around his knuckles while hundreds of blazing golden sword-light streaks launch continuously from behind his back, shooting past both shoulders straight toward the foreground like a torrential meteor rain; his clean pale face remains impeccably composed—smooth relaxed brows, softly closed lips, steady cold gaze. Camera holds steady with a subtle slow push.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, the camera cuts to a blistering high-speed chase perspective racing forward through open canyon air directly behind the blazing white-gold spearhead of the golden energy beam as it streaks straight ahead above the intact green pine canopy of <Subject 2> toward an unharmed distant craggy peak on the horizon; white sonic vapor cones peel backward off the advancing beam tip while shockwave wind flattens pine treetops below on both sides. Camera hurtles straight forward chasing the advancing beam head.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a locked stationary high-altitude aerial wide shot with <Subject 1> already hovering steady in the lower-left foreground in billowing ivory-gold robes, thrusting his right arm diagonally forward toward the upper-right: a massive golden energy beam surges continuously outward from his palm at the lower-left straight across the valley, propelling luminous golden shockwave rings rapidly away from his hand up the shaft toward the upper-right mountain peak; upon impact at the upper-right peak, a colossal dome of shattered rock, golden fire, and shockwave dust erupts outward away into the upper-right sky through the final frame. Locked aerial camera holds steady and shudders subtly as the distant peak explodes.

overall_soundscape: Crystalline chorus of ringing swords, mountain gale whipping silk robes, rising sub-bass vortex hum, torrential whoosh of launching light-swords, supersonic canyon wind roar, and a delayed thunderous distant mountain explosion.

non_diegetic_music: Majestic epic guzheng and deep orchestral strings building tension through the sword wing expansion and fist charge, pausing for a split beat at launch before erupting into thunderous brass and taiko drums as the beam strikes the distant peak.
